profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | .NET & RPA Architect | UiPath | Pega Robotics | LoanIQ Automation Expert
profile.summary:
Experienced Lead Consultant | Automation Architect | .NET & RPA Specialist

With over 25 years in IT and deep expertise in process automation, custom application development, and system integration, I specialize in building enterprise-grade automation solutions that simplify complex banking and lending operations.

I have successfully led automation initiatives for major U.S. financial institutions—streamlining loan operations, reconciliation, and reporting across multiple platforms, including ACBS, LoanIQ, Versana, and Loan Runner.

My technical strengths span .NET (C#, VB.NET), UiPath, Pega Robotics, Oracle, and SQL Server, combined with a focus on scalable architecture and intelligent automation frameworks.

Recognized through multiple Infosys Awards of Excellence (2023, 2020) and the Eureka Award (2024), I’m passionate about delivering measurable business impact through innovation, precision, and automation-led transformation.

Specialties: RPA (UiPath, Pega Robotics), .NET Architecture, Process Optimization, LoanIQ Automation, Data Integration, and Technical Leadership.

positions.title: Lead Consultant
positions.description:
Leading automation architecture and solution design for enterprise lending operations, improving accuracy, efficiency, and compliance across multiple systems.

Key Achievements:

Designed and deployed the Lender Reconciliation Tool integrating ACBS, LoanIQ, Versana, and Loan Runner, improving reconciliation accuracy by ~90%.

Automated Wire Matching, linking incoming wires to payments and advances in LoanIQ to confirm fund receipt and release transactions automatically.

Developed end-to-end automations for Deferral Interest Notices, Expense Code Updates, and Year-End Tax Advises—streamlining document handling via Documentum.

Built Funding Rates Automation integrated with Global Data Analytics (GDA) for real-time rate sourcing and repricing.

Engineered automation for Payoff Letter Generation, LoanIQ Advances/Payments, and Trade Shipping Label Generation through the bank’s MyShipping portal for DHL, FedEx, UPS.

Mentored RPA developers and drove governance across UiPath and Pega automation projects.

Awards: Eureka Award (2024), Infosys Award of Excellence (2023, 2020).

positions.title: Lead Consultant
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Robotic Process automation using Pega Robotics (OpenSpan) Studio.
Design and development of bots for EPDS v2 Automation.
Technical guidance to automation team for development and deployment.
Architecture design, development and unit testing, team leading and peer review.

positions.title: Assistant Consultant
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Robotic Process automation using Pega Robotics (OpenSpan) Studio.
Design and development of bots for Assignment Desk Report processing.
Parsing email, excel, mht, word and text files, parsing screen and PDF using OCR capability.
Maintenance and Enhancement in iCon bot to Parse Notices and process service requests.
Technical guidance to automation team for development and deployment.
Architecture design, development and unit testing, team leading and peer review.
Requirement analysis, estimation and progress tracking.
Production support to resolve user reported issues.

positions.title: Manager Consultant
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Technical guidance to development, automation and testing team. 
Architecture design, Development and unit testing, team leading and peer review.
Requirement analysis, estimation, sprint planning, task distribution and tracking.
Managing project activities and report status to stake holders.
Staffing and resource planning for the team.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Technical guidance to development and testing team.
Architecture design of desktop applications.
Requirement analysis, estimation, sprint planning, team leading and peer review. 
Design and development of Razor Engine View pages, Model, Controller & business logic layer components

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Requirement analysis, estimation, planning, team leading. 
Migrating to MEF framework to support plug-ins for changing business rules.
Enterprise library integration for data access, caching, exception handling and logging.
Design and development of windows services, ASPX pages, business logic and data access layer components, stored procedures and code review

Performance tuning of stored procedures
